{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Flight Datatrans''' was a document that was required reading at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] for all [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]-candidates. It contained a section on the tradition of using [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], their role in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the expectations of the [[TIE pilot]]s assigned to fly them.
